registration_scope: Before data download/inspection; literature and file inventory already reviewed. No prospective natural-world claim.
question: Does the published dataset permit construction-energy integration and a fully accounted useful-output-after-damage experiment?
required_for_energy_integration: time-resolved voltage and current from the same growth run
admission_requires: blind damage and fresh reconstruction provenance
physically attainable resource-matched independent and shuffled controls
positive post-damage and whole-life surplus after all maintenance costs
missing_value_policy: unknown, never zero or a favorable fitted value
stop: If required measurements are absent, preserve the source and identify the missing measurement. Do not replace transient construction energy with DC conductivity, capacitance, projected area or voltage alone.
interpretation: Unknown cost is not physical impossibility. Published powered growth is not Ora reproduction, autonomous origin, self-maintenance or learning.
